subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Wikipedia: The People's Encyclopedia
description: One-minute skill: Wikipedia: The People's Encyclopedia.

hook.text: Jimmy Wales launched Wikipedia in 2001 with a radical idea: anyone can edit any article.

buildup.text: Volunteers wrote millions of articles in hundreds of languages, all for free.

discovery.text: Wikipedia became the sixth most visited website and the largest encyclopedia in history.

twist.text: Experts predicted chaos. Instead, the community developed governance to maintain quality.

climax.text: Wikipedia proved that collective knowledge, freely shared, could rival professional encyclopedias.

punchline.text: Volunteers built the world's largest encyclopedia.
